# Walter Blythe

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013), [v5 c4 P21](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0021)</sub>
- **Origin:** Ingleside, Glen St. Mary  <sub>[v5 c3 P1](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0001), [v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c16 P20](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0020)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Walter  <sub>[v5 c17 P9](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

Walter is a very handsome boy with straight black hair, a finely modelled face, and large, dark gray eyes that are full of joy, sorrow, and aspiration. He is slender and possesses a fair, delicate complexion that flushes easily when he is excited or ashamed.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P12](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0012), [v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013), [v5 c16 P21](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0021), [v5 c17 P41](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0041)_

## Personality

Walter is a sensitive, imaginative, and deeply poetic soul who cherishes a passion for beauty in nature and literature. He possesses a vivid imagination and a dramatic way of speaking that captivates and thrills his friends. Though sensitive to pain, averse to violence, and terrified of fighting, he harbors a strong sense of honor, courage, and chivalry that drives him to defend others when insulted.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c8 P28](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0028), [v5 c16 P16](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0016), [v5 c16 P25](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0025), [v5 c17 P61](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0061)_

## Traits

- Imaginative and poetic  <sub>[v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014)</sub>
- Sensitive to pain and beauty  <sub>[v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013), [v5 c16 P16](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0016)</sub>
- Fear of physical pain and ugliness  <sub>[v5 c16 P12](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0012), [v5 c16 P16](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0016)</sub>
- Chivalrous and honorable  <sub>[v5 c17 P30](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0030), [v5 c17 P57](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0057)</sub>

## Abilities

- Writing poetry and stories  <sub>[v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c4 P24](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0024)</sub>
- Dramatic storytelling and reading  <sub>[v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c8 P11](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0011)</sub>

## Goals

- To become a great poet like his 'Uncle' Paul Irving  <sub>[v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014)</sub>

## History

Walter grew up at Ingleside in Glen St. Mary, spending his leisure time exploring the nearby woods and Rainbow Valley with his brothers, sisters, and the Meredith children from the manse. Often considered 'girly' by schoolmates because he preferred reading poetry to fighting or participating in rough sports, Walter nevertheless commanded a quiet respect for his eloquence and storytelling ability. During a summer evening in Rainbow Valley, he introduced the myth of the Pied Piper to his companions, experiencing a chilling premonition that he and the other boys would one day be called away to follow a distant piper. When Dan Reese insulted his mother's writings and called Faith Meredith names, Walter overcame his deep-seated dread of violence and challenged Dan to a fight. Despite agonizing over the upcoming fistfight for an entire night, Walter stood his ground, fought fiercely, and defeated Dan, earning a newfound confidence and the respect of those around him. He later made peace with his fears by voluntarily going to the dentist to have a troublesome tooth extracted.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P1](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0001), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c8 P23](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0023), [v5 c8 P25](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0025), [v5 c16 P21](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0021), [v5 c16 P39](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0039), [v5 c17 P42](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0042), [v5 c17 P55](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0055), [v5 c17 P71](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0071)_

## Background by volume

- Born at Ingleside, Glen St. Mary, as the second son of Gilbert and Anne Blythe  <sub>[v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 c3 P13](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0013)</sub>
- Named Rainbow Valley alongside his siblings and friends  <sub>[v5 c3 P1](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0001)</sub>
- Won a school poetry prize offered by his teacher  <sub>[v5 c4 P24](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0024)</sub>

## Quotes

> How the air shines to-night. The flower angel has been walking over the world to-day, calling to the flowers. I can see his blue wings on that hill by the woods.  <sub>[v5 c3 P20](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0020)</sub>

> Some day the Pied Piper will come over the hill up there and down Rainbow Valley, piping merrily and sweetly. And I will follow him—follow him down to the shore—down to the sea—away from you all. I don't think I'll want to go—Jem will want to go—it will be such an adventure—but I won't. Only I'll have to—the music will call and call and call me until I must follow.  <sub>[v5 c8 P23](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0023)</sub>

> I didn't say I would run. I said I wanted to run. That's a different thing. I want to help people, too. But oh, I wish there weren't any ugly, dreadful things in the world. I wish everything was glad and beautiful.  <sub>[v5 c16 P18](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0018)</sub>

> I never fought before—and I didn't want to right up to the last—and then I liked it while I was at it.  <sub>[v5 c17 P68](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0068)</sub>

> I'm not going to be frightened any more, sir. Being frightened of things is worse than the things themselves.  <sub>[v5 c17 P71](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0071)</sub>
